feature_sources: fixed public pretrained first layer in both conditions
input_sources: released expert for pass 1; attacker-computable parameter merge of the cached pass-1 reconstruction for pass 2
target: released control MLP evaluated on selected frozen inputs; no original-merged inputs used for fitting pass 2
fitting: same 256 frozen unlabeled SVHN images in both passes; four MLPs fitted independently, no sequential updates of the context model

query_budget.scope: two passes use twice the target-query budget; not a matched-query comparison

local_check: same 32 disjoint calibration images per task; original-merged check inputs are diagnostic only and never used for fitting
selection: one declared second pass; no choice of round count, feature basis or ridge based on evaluation
evaluation: same previously inspected SVHN 4000 and MNIST 2000 training subsets; not a fresh holdout
scope: adaptive functional-reconstruction control on an unprotected released model; not a new defense or a demonstrated protected-model attack
